scenes.title: Truth in the Courtyard
scenes.summary: Roman explains how he accidentally swapped suitcases with Larisa on Monday's train and panicked at the gate.

scenes.title: Three Years of Silence
scenes.summary: At the front desk Matvey unlocks the blue suitcase for Roman, who explains the three-year silence with his brother Gleb.

scenes.title: Friday Lemon Cake
scenes.summary: Larisa recalls what the brothers always ate after Friday piano lessons, giving Zoya a bright baking idea.

scenes.title: Two Chairs Under the Tree
scenes.summary: Kira, Zoya, and Matvey arrange a quiet corner table under the courtyard tree and check the string of lanterns.

scenes.title: Simple Words First
scenes.summary: At eleven forty Roman practices stiff speeches in the courtyard until Kira helps him choose three simple, honest lines.

scenes.title: Ten Minutes to Twelve
scenes.summary: At eleven fifty the postman drops off an official registered letter for Yaroslav, who sets it aside to greet noon.

scenes.title: Twelve Chimes
scenes.summary: Twelve o'clock strikes with an empty gate, Roman loses hope for a long minute, and then a taxi brakes outside.

scenes.title: The Red-Stamped Letter
scenes.summary: As Gleb steps into the courtyard outside, Yaroslav opens the landlord's letter inside and turns pale at a sale notice.
